summary: Tested public backend and frontend end-to-end. Core requested ERP flows pass: admin auth/me, dashboard contracts and charts, customer/motorcycle creation, service-order totals/stock/ledger/status, payments/current accounts, reports, RBAC, sidebar navigation, customer dialog, fault marking, order creation, status change, and tahsilat. Security playbook has 2 failures, and Current Accounts breaks on mobile.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout: six consecutive invalid passwords all returned 401; the required sixth response should be 423/429 after five failures.
Credentialed CORS is configured with CORS_ORIGINS='*' instead of explicit allowed frontend origins.

minor.issue: Resource creation endpoints return 200 instead of the conventional 201 Created status. Payloads and persistence otherwise passed.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px viewport the table is about 609px wide and has no horizontal overflow wrapper, clipping Harcama/Tahsilat/Bakiye columns off-screen.

issues: Six-column table is not responsive or horizontally scrollable; key financial values cannot be reached on mobile.

action_items: Implement persistent, time-windowed login failure counting and lock accounts or return 429 after five failed attempts; reset counters after successful login.
Set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit trusted frontend origin(s) when allow_credentials=True.
Wrap Current Accounts table in overflow-x-auto or provide a responsive card/column-priority layout.

Add transactional validation to service-order/payment writes: verify motorcycle belongs to customer, prevent insufficient/negative stock, verify payment customer matches order, and reject overpayment.
Retest security and mobile behavior after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: create_service_order decrements stock before inserting the order/ledger and does not use a Mongo transaction; partial failures can leave stock inconsistent, and stock can go negative.
create_service_order checks that customer and motorcycle exist but not that motorcycle.customer_id equals customer_id, allowing mismatched ownership and enrichment.
create_payment does not validate that customer_id matches the referenced order and permits paid_total to exceed grand_total.
payment_no uses second-level timestamp only and has no uniqueness enforcement, so simultaneous payments can share a receipt number.
Frontend API effects generally have no rendered error state and several useEffect chains only attach .then; failed requests can leave indefinite 'Yükleniyor…' or empty content.
Multiple interactive controls outside the primary requested flows lack data-testid attributes (for example Services and Settings create-user controls), reducing regression-test stability.
Backend server.py is 965 lines and combines models, auth, CRUD, reporting, and seeding; split into focused routers/services.

Seed admin password-update behavior is present in code, bcrypt hash was verified as $2b$, and login Set-Cookie was verified HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=None. The referenced /app/auth_testing.md file is absent.

success_rate.backend: 84.6% (11/13 tests; all requested functional flows passed, 2 security checks failed)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested desktop E2E flows passed; 1 mobile responsive check failed)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed customers, motorcycles, products, catalog services, service orders, payments, and one non-admin RBAC user during regression runs; cleanup script removed all identified QA records afterward.
test_credentials: Used the admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; credentials were valid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Final pytest result is 11 passed/2 failed. Failures are intentionally retained for brute-force lockout and explicit-origin CORS. Desktop UI login/dashboard/sidebar/customer/service-order/status/payment flows passed. Recheck CurrentAccounts at 390x844 after responsive fix. Production frontend build succeeds with React hook dependency warnings in Customers, Motorcycles, Products, ServiceOrderDetail, and ServiceOrders.
rca_of_the_issue: Auth login performs only bcrypt verification and has no failed-attempt storage, time window, or lockout branch, so every bad attempt remains 401. CORS reads backend CORS_ORIGINS, currently '*', while allow_credentials=True. CurrentAccounts renders a six-column min-w-full table directly inside CardContent without an overflow-x-auto container or mobile alternative.
